title: Hepatitis after transfusion in the NIH's prospective studies, 1967–1990s
description: Bar chart. Share of transfusion recipients who developed hepatitis: about 33% around 1970, when paid blood was untested; about 10% after volunteers and HBsAg screening; 4% by 1989; 1.5% after the first hepatitis C antibody test in 1990; close to zero after the second-generation test of 1992. Data: Alter and Klein, Blood 112 (2008): 2618–19.
heading: RECIPIENTS WITH HEPATITIS AFTER TRANSFUSION, NIH
